Scrobbling is optional. When enabled, MusicBridge sends track metadata and listening times to your chosen server.
Ever stumbled across system not wanting to control your music player?
Not showing in your \"Dynamic Island\"? Not showing a fancy widget in Quick Settings?
That is probably because your device manufacturer implemented a whitelist for these features.
That in most cases include a lot of Chinese streaming services and (sometimes) Spotify.
And that is where MusicBridge steps in!
Acting as a proxy between your favorite application and the OS, MusicBridge allows you to break the chains and enjoy your music fully.
Save listens from the mirrored player to ListenBrainz. Tracks need a title and artist.
For Maloja, use https://your-server/apis/listenbrainz. The /1 suffix is added automatically. Use a ListenBrainz-compatible API, not the native Maloja API.
Enter an HTTPS URL without a login, query or fragment. For HTTP, explicitly allow an unencrypted connection.
HTTP exposes your key and listening data to the network. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
Enter a valid user token or API key from the selected server.
Unable to connect or save the token. Check your connection and try again.
The server rejected the key or it could not be read. Connect again to resume sending queued listens.
The key is encrypted on this device. Enter it again to connect a new address. Connecting a different server or account discards the previous queue.
Send listens to the connected server
Turning this off stops tracking and discards queued listens.
Start the MusicBridge service in Settings to track new listens.
Half the track duration, up to 4 minutes
Pauses, buffering and seeks do not count as listening time. With no track duration, the half-track mode uses 4 minutes.
For a Maloja server: “Artist 1, Artist 2” is sent as two artists using the native API. Applies only to new listens; the existing queue is unchanged.
Keep this off if a comma is part of a single artist’s name, such as “Earth, Wind & Fire”.
Queued listens survive app restarts and wait for a connection. Temporary failures and rate limits are retried automatically.
